notes: Discontinued 3.3 cu ft white compact fridge with manual defrost; the spec sheet gives R600a refrigerant and the owner's manual warns that it is flammable. The spec sheet lists a mechanical thermostat, and the shared FTC label for the DCR033B1BM/WM/SLM/SLM-6 shows 220 kWh a year of estimated electricity use.

gaps: The manual and energy label also cover DCR033B1BM, DCR033B1SLM and DCR033B1SLM-6; the parts list is for the DCR033B1WM only.
The 110-120 V, 60 Hz rating is on the compressor row and the AC 250 V, 6(4) A, 50/60 Hz rating is on the thermostat row: no rating for the unit itself was found.
The energy label PDF has no text layer; the 220 kWh figure was read from a render of page 1 (US EnergyGuide, with a Canadian EnerGuide label beside it).
The parts list shows one refrigerator shelf (quantity 1) while the spec sheet and product page list a full-width and a half-width glass shelf; each is recorded as its source shows it.
The parts list gives a door gasket (3020400226, white); the manual only calls it a rubber gasket, so no magnet claim is made.
The spec sheet prints 'Amount of Refrigerant 22' with no unit, so no charge is recorded.

The parts page does not list the compressor and shows the thermostat, overload protector and door gasket as no longer available; the parts list marks several rows special order: stock notes, not claims about the unit.
Document dates (parts list effective 2019-09-09; manual 2019-07-22) are not production years.

Danby Energy Guide label PDF (image only): page 1 rendered at 110 dpi and read by eye.

No site refused; no bot checks on Danby domains.
